name: Education Major

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a minimum total of 150 units, which includes a major from the Faculties of Applied Sciences; or Arts and Social Sciences; or Communication, Art and Technology; or Environment; or Science, and all of the following.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students who have been accepted into the Professional Development Program (PDP) must complete the following.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students who have been accepted into the Professional Linking Program (PLP) must complete the following.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of 90 units in upper division courses (numbered 300 and 400) · two of.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Both a minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 2.0 and a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 2.0 calculated on all upper division courses completed at Simon Fraser University.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: To complete the program, a student must make application, and be accepted to the professional development program.

sections.note:

Curriculum and Instruction Minor Program

Elementary Generalist Minor Program

two education designs for learning courses
See Professional Development Programs for further details.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
